sbx put /app/analyze_logs.py <<'EOF'
import glob, os, re, csv
from datetime import date, timedelta

ref = date(2025, 8, 12)
ranges = [
    ("today", ref, ref),
    ("last_7_days", ref - timedelta(days=6), ref),
    ("last_30_days", ref - timedelta(days=29), ref),
    ("month_to_date", ref.replace(day=1), ref),
]
severities = ["ERROR", "WARNING", "INFO"]
counts = {name: {s: 0 for s in severities} for name, _, _ in ranges}
counts["total"] = {s: 0 for s in severities}

pat = re.compile(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}.*?\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]")
for path in glob.glob("/app/logs/*.log"):
    m = re.match(r"(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})_", os.path.basename(path))
    if not m:
        continue
    d = date.fromisoformat(m.group(1))
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            sm = pat.search(line)
            if not sm:
                continue
            sev = sm.group(1)
            counts["total"][sev] += 1
            for name, start, end in ranges:
                if start <= d <= end:
                    counts[name][sev] += 1

with open("/app/summary.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["period", "severity", "count"])
    for name, _, _ in ranges + [("total", None, None)]:
        for s in severities:
            w.writerow([name, s, counts[name][s]])
EOF
sbx run 'python3 /app/analyze_logs.py && cat /app/summary.csv'

sbx run 'python3 - <<PY

        total+=1
        m=re.match(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}.*?\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]",ln)
        if m: c[m.group(1)]+=1
        else:
            mm=re.search(r"\[([A-Z]+)\]",ln)
            unmatched[mm.group(1) if mm else "NOBRACKET"]+=1
print("total lines",total)
print("matched",c,sum(c.values()))
print("unmatched",unmatched)
PY'
